territorial_scope.description: Designations of Irish public bodies under the EU AI Act, operating within Ireland.

evidence.quote: the Minister is designated as a national competent authority

summary.short: Designates Irish bodies as national competent authorities, market surveillance authorities, notifying authorities and single point of contact under the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689). Made 25 July 2025 under the European Communities Act 1972; the Minister, Central Bank of Ireland, Data Protection Commission and others hold roles.
summary.long: Made 25 July 2025 by the Minister for Enterprise, Tourism and Employment under section 3 of the European Communities Act 1972 to give further effect to the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689). Regulation 3 designates the Minister as a national competent authority under Article 70(1) and, through the Schedule, names market surveillance authorities as national competent authorities for specified points of Section A, Annex I, including the Health and Safety Authority, the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission, the Marine Survey Office, the Commission for Communications Regulation, the Commission for Railway Regulation and the Health Products Regulatory Authority. Regulation 4 designates the Central Bank of Ireland as market surveillance authority for Article 74(6) and the Data Protection Commission for Article 74(8). Regulation 5 designates notifying authorities under Article 28 for listed Annex I legislation: the Minister, the Minister for Transport, the Health Products Regulatory Authority and the Commission for Communications Regulation. Regulation 6 designates the Minister as single point of contact under Article 70(2). The Regulations set no obligations for private actors, no thresholds and no penalties.

relations.note: Stated purpose is giving further effect to the Regulation. The instrument designates national competent authorities (Art. 70(1)), market surveillance authorities (Art. 74(6), 74(8)), notifying authorities (Art. 28) and a single point of contact (Art. 70(2)).

notes: Designation instrument only: it does not, on its face, amend, repeal or transpose any other instrument. The text of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and of Annex I Section A is not reproduced; the Schedule refers to Annex I points 1 to 12 without their content. Points to note: Reg. 2(1) defines 'Marine Survey Office' as part of the Department of Transport, and Reg. 5(b) makes the Minister for Transport notifying authority for Annex I points 3 and 8, while the Schedule names the Marine Survey Office (point 3) and the Commission for Railway Regulation (point 8) as market surveillance authorities; these are different functions, not a conflict. Points 9 and 10 of the Schedule are each split by sub-category (consumer products vs personal protective equipment; domestic vs non-domestic gas appliances). The definition of 'Artificial Intelligence Regulation' in Reg. 2(1) contains a stray footnote marker ('20241'). Dates in the text: notice in Iris Oifigiúil of 29 July 2025; 'GIVEN' on 25 July 2025.

thresholds.note: The instrument designates authorities and assigns them to Article 70(1), 70(2), 74(6), 74(8), 28 and Annex I, Section A points. The numbers in the text are citations of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 provisions, S.I. and Act numbers, dates and schedule reference numbers. None is a numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment of an entity, product or person, so no threshold rows are coded.
